gemini.title: Guide: Getting a Gemini API Key
gemini.subtitle: Step-by-step instructions for creating a free API key in Google AI Studio
gemini.step1Title: Step 1. Go to Google AI Studio
gemini.step1Desc: Open the Google AI Studio developer portal and sign in with your Google account.
gemini.step1Hint: If the portal is unavailable in your region, a VPN connection may be required.
gemini.step2Desc: In the left sidebar or center panel, click the «Create API key» (or «Get API key») button. Then select «Create API key in new project».
gemini.step3Desc: In the modal dialog that appears, click the copy icon next to the key string (keys start with the «AIza...» prefix).
gemini.step4Desc: Return to GameMind settings, paste your key into the «API Key» field, and click «Save Changes» at the bottom of the screen.
gemini.benefitsTitle: Why a personal key is the best choice:
gemini.benefit1: Completely free: 15 requests per minute and 1,000,000 tokens per day.
gemini.benefit2: No credit card required: Google does not ask for payment details on the Free Tier.
gemini.benefit3: Zero queueing: dedicated quota removes GameMind generation limits.
gemini.benefit4: Safe & local: your key is stored strictly on your PC and never shared.

openai.title: Guide: Getting an OpenAI API Key
openai.subtitle: Step-by-step instructions for creating an API key on the OpenAI Platform
openai.step1Title: Step 1. Sign in to OpenAI Platform
openai.step1Desc: Open the OpenAI Platform developer portal and sign in to your account (or register a new one).
openai.step1Hint: A VPN connection may be required to access the OpenAI Platform in certain countries.
openai.step2Desc: Please note: OpenAI API uses a separate pay-as-you-go balance (ChatGPT Plus does not include API credits). Navigate to Settings -> Billing and add a minimum of $5 to activate your API access.
openai.step3Desc: Go to the «API keys» section, click «Create new secret key», enter a name (e.g. GameMind), and click «Create secret key».
openai.step4Title: Step 4. Copy and paste into GameMind
openai.step4Desc: Copy the key immediately (starts with «sk-...») as OpenAI only shows it once. Paste it into the «API Key» field in GameMind settings and click «Save Changes».
openai.benefit1: Flagship models: access to state-of-the-art GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini models.
openai.benefit2: Pay-as-you-go: you only pay fractions of a cent per token processed.
openai.benefit3: High availability: dedicated quotas and reliable server throughput.
openai.benefit4: Safe & local: your key is stored strictly on your PC in encrypted format.

claude.title: Guide: Getting a Claude API Key
claude.subtitle: Step-by-step instructions for creating an API key on the Anthropic Console
claude.step1Title: Step 1. Sign in to Anthropic Console
claude.step1Desc: Navigate to the Anthropic Console developer portal and log in to your account (or register a new one).
claude.step1Hint: A VPN connection may be required to access the Anthropic Console in certain countries.
claude.step2Desc: Please note: Anthropic API operates on a pay-as-you-go basis (Claude Pro subscription does not include API credits). Go to Settings -> Plans & Billing and deposit a minimum of $5.
claude.step3Desc: Go to the «API Keys» section in the left sidebar, click the «Create Key» button, enter a name (e.g. GameMind), and click confirm.
claude.step4Title: Step 4. Copy and paste into GameMind
claude.step4Desc: Copy your generated key (starts with «sk-ant-api03-...»), paste it into the «API Key» field in GameMind settings, and click «Save Changes».
claude.benefit1: Top-tier intelligence: access to industry-leading Claude 3.5 Sonnet for game analysis.
claude.benefit2: Pay-as-you-go: you only pay fractions of a cent strictly per generated response.
claude.benefit3: Massive context: huge context window capable of deep library and timeline reasoning.
claude.benefit4: Safe & local: your key is stored strictly on your PC in encrypted format.

openrouter.title: Guide: Getting an OpenRouter API Key
openrouter.subtitle: Step-by-step instructions for creating a unified API key on OpenRouter
openrouter.step1Desc: Open openrouter.ai/keys and sign in via Google, Discord, GitHub, or Email.
openrouter.step1Hint: OpenRouter aggregates hundreds of models from DeepSeek, Meta, OpenAI, and Google under a single API key.
openrouter.step2Title: Step 2. Free models or Credit Top-up
openrouter.step2Desc: OpenRouter offers both completely free models (:free) and premium models. To access top models, you can top up credits under the Credits tab with any custom amount.
openrouter.step3Title: Step 3. Create a new API key
openrouter.step3Desc: In the «Keys» section, click «Create Key», name your key (e.g. GameMind), optionally set a spending limit, and click «Create».
openrouter.step4Title: Step 4. Copy and paste into GameMind
openrouter.step4Desc: Copy the generated key (starts with «sk-or-v1-...»), paste it into the «API Key» field in GameMind settings, and click «Save Changes».
openrouter.benefit1: All-in-one access: one key connects to DeepSeek, Llama 3.3, Claude, GPT-4o, and hundreds more.
openrouter.benefit2: Free options: access multiple capable models without adding payment details.
openrouter.benefit3: Flexible payments: supports credit card and crypto top-ups with no subscription lock-in.
openrouter.benefit4: Safe & local: your key is stored strictly on your PC in encrypted format.

ollama.title: Guide: Setting Up Ollama
ollama.subtitle: Step-by-step instructions for installing and running local models via Ollama
ollama.step1Desc: Go to the official ollama.com website, download the installer for your OS, and complete setup.
ollama.step1Hint: Ollama runs open-weights AI models directly on your PC's CPU or GPU.
ollama.step2Desc: Open your terminal (PowerShell or CMD) and run: ollama run llama3.2 (or ollama run mistral / ollama run qwen2.5).
ollama.step3Desc: Ollama automatically runs in the background and is accessible at http://localhost:11434.
ollama.step4Title: Step 4. Enter the URL in GameMind
ollama.step4Desc: Enter http://localhost:11434 in the «Local Server URL» field and click «Save Changes» at the bottom of the screen.
ollama.benefit1: 100% Free & offline: runs without internet or active subscriptions.
ollama.benefit2: Total privacy: your gaming data never leaves your computer.
ollama.benefit3: No rate limits: unlimited requests and token processing.
ollama.benefit4: Wide variety: supports Llama 3, Mistral, Qwen, Gemma, and more.

lmstudio.title: Guide: Setting Up LM Studio
lmstudio.subtitle: Step-by-step instructions for running a local server with LM Studio
lmstudio.step1Title: Step 1. Download and install LM Studio
lmstudio.step1Desc: Navigate to the official lmstudio.ai website, download the app, and install it on your PC.
lmstudio.step1Hint: LM Studio provides a clean graphical interface to discover, download, and host open LLMs.
lmstudio.step2Title: Step 2. Download a model via search
lmstudio.step2Desc: Use the in-app search in LM Studio to find and download a model (e.g. Llama 3.2 3B, Qwen 2.5 7B, or Mistral 7B).
lmstudio.step3Desc: Switch to the «Local Server» tab in the left sidebar, select your loaded model at the top, and click «Start Server» (default port: 1234).
lmstudio.step4Title: Step 4. Enter the URL in GameMind
lmstudio.step4Desc: Ensure the «Local Server URL» is set to http://localhost:1234 and click «Save Changes».
lmstudio.benefit1: User-friendly GUI: find, download, and host LLMs in just a few clicks.
lmstudio.benefit2: Complete independence: local inference powered by your GPU/CPU.
lmstudio.benefit3: Zero costs: no API keys, accounts, or quotas required.
lmstudio.benefit4: OpenAI compatibility: standard local REST endpoints.
